page_title: MNT 2-2 HAV | Montpellier v Le Havre 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' 2 - 2 Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) scores a goal! He latches onto a lovely pass that puts him one-on-one with the keeper before producing a fine strike that goes into the left side of the net!
90' Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
86' Lucas Mincarelli comes onto the pitch after Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
86' Substitution. Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Daler Kuzyaev walks off.
85' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
85' That was close. Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
80' 5:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
77' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Elye Wahi (Montpellier) replaces Akor Adams.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) for Jordan Ferri.
76' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
71' Here comes a substitution. Teji Savanier is given a rest as he is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
70' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Loic Nego is replaced by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre).
70' Substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye makes way for Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) coming on for Wahbi Khazri.
65' The game is interrupted. Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
61' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Nabil Alioui and he is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
61' It will be a substitution. Andy Logbo (Le Havre) is ready to enter the pitch as Issa Soumare walks off.

60' 2 - 1 Stunning strike! Akor Adams (Montpellier) latches on to a precise through ball from Kiki Kouyate before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 2:1.

58' 1 - 1 Teji Savanier produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Akor Adams (Montpellier) rises high to head the ball low into the middle of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:1.
58' Now Montpellier have a corner.

58' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
57' Loic Nego (Le Havre) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

56' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.
55' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Arouna Sangante (Le Havre), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
55' Akor Adams (Montpellier) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas makes a magnificent save!

54' The game is interrupted. Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Montpellier are awarded the free kick.
52' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
48' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Christopher Jullien (Montpellier) for a tough tackle.

47' Montpellier are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Clement Turpin blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
45+5' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45+3' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+2' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
45' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
39' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
37' The ball possession is 65:35.
36' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
22' Flag up against Teji Savanier (Montpellier). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
21' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
15' The referee blows his whistle as Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) was too aggressive in his challenge.
12' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yoann Salmier (Le Havre).
8' Clement Turpin sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
7' Wait! Referee Clement Turpin has indicated he is going to review the Montpellier goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 0:1.
5' Clement Turpin blows his whistle. Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
3' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
